review.rationale: Q001明确冗余，源参数[3]及1156零参模板/版本不变，精确绑定和档案SHA校验授权，不泛化参数冲突。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 保留原[3]，实际击败且自身存活时按技能源恢复自身最大HP量及全部PP；未击败/免攻无KO不触发，技能禁疗/回复倍率及PP回复封锁存活条件独立。

success.name: 4947/1156真实零参模板与冗余实例3均保留，非击败不触发，击败真实全HP全PP
success.assertion: test('4947/1156真实零参模板与冗余实例3均保留，非击败不触发，击败真实全HP全PP',()=>{assert.equal(source.effects.find(e=>e.id===1156).argsNum,0);assert.deepEqual(source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38541).effectInstances[4].args,[3]);const s=H.make({move:38541,index:4,hp:1000,loadout});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[H.key(38541)].operations.find(op=>op.effectId===1156).sourceArgs,[3]);H.turn(s,38541,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[H.key(38541)],4);const p=H.make({move:38541,index:4,hp:1000,targetHp:1,loadout});H.turn(p,38541,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[H.key(38541)],5);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].hp,0);for(const k of p.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[k],p.moveDefinitions[k].pp);});

success.name: 4947已答1156保留真实实例3按零参语义：实际击败回满HP全部PP，未击败和零红免伤不触发，回复限制分别处理
success.assertion: test('4947已答1156保留真实实例3按零参语义：实际击败回满HP全部PP，未击败和零红免伤不触发，回复限制分别处理',()=>{for(const mode of ['ko','alive','immune','skillBan','half','ppBan']){const s=make({move:38541,index:4,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='alive'?9000:1}),a=s.fighters[0];for(const k of a.moves)a.pp[k]=2;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='half')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='ppBan'){s.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;timer(s,1,'机械领域',{fraction:.6});}turn(s,38541,20309);const ko=!['alive','immune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp===0,ko);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,ko?mode==='skillBan'?1000:mode==='half'?5500:9000:1000);for(const k of a.moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],ko?s.moveDefinitions[k].pp:k===key(38541)?1:2);assert.deepEqual(source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38541).effectInstances[4].args,[3]);}});
